provenance.source: Eight fictional tickets for exercising the review workflow
provenance.split_policy: Four development and four test fixtures, with distinct fictional groups; not representative evaluation data

tickets.text: My card was charged twice for one purchase.
The tracking page has shown the same location for a week.
The link to reset my password has expired.
My refund was approved, but the money has not arrived.
The courier marked my parcel delivered and I cannot find it.
The verification code for signing in never arrives.
I was charged twice, and my password no longer works.
